requirements.rule: SENIORITY (Arts. 40, 44-46): the scatti were frozen at 31/12/2015 and consolidated by the CCNL 2016-2018; those amounts and the salario di anzianità of the earlier renewals are the worker's own. Supply each preserved monthly balance as IndividualElement(code='legacy_scatti' or 'legacy_seniority_salary', monthly=<worker balance>, absorbable=False, as_of=None, extra_months=True, tfr_relevant=True). Art. 40 lists them as fixed pay, Art. 46 adds the new payment to the old amount, and Art. 49 includes gross pay in the thirteenth; Art. 93 includes recurring pay in the TFR base. No amount for an old worker is given in the current PDF. The salario di anzianità of Art. 46 from 1 September 2025 (15 EUR levels I-IV, 20 EUR levels V-VIII, 13 payments, two years of uninterrupted service on that day) is a fixed allowance of every level (in_service_on 2023-09-01). Approximated: 'servizio ininterrotto presso lo stesso Ente' is read from the start of the employment period, so an interruption or a change of Ente before 1 September 2025 is not read, and the amount follows the level of the run instead of the level held on 1 September 2025.
requirements.remediation: Supply any actual preserved monthly balances as individual elements and, for the new allowance, the level held and whether service with the same employer was uninterrupted on 1 September 2025; absent those facts, the run cannot reconstruct the worker's historical pay or correct the milestone approximation.
